131:                             or record.phase is not Phase.QUARANTINED or record.protection is not None
132:                             or owner._revoked is not True or owner._closed_verified is not True
133:                             or owner._closing is not True or type(owner._active) is not int or owner._active != 0
134:                             or token.revoked is not True or token.phase != "CLEARED" or token.pending is not None
135:                             or token.gate in service._live or token.physical in attempt.gates._held
